info.name: Dime - OAuth, SMS, Customers, Loans and Transion
info.description: Set base_url, consumer_key and consumer_secret, then run Get access token. Token is saved automatically. All resource requests inherit Bearer auth. Set sample=true for authenticated synthetic responses with no live actions. sample=false (the default) or omission uses live APIs. Transion examples are illustrative. Callback requires bearer authentication.
